items.question: Do I need to give access to my bank account?
items.answer: No. You upload a statement file from Kaspi or Halyk yourself — Esep never connects to your account directly or asks for passwords.

items.question: Does Esep replace an accountant?
items.answer: No, it's a simple tool for estimating profit and tax under the simplified regime or patent. For complex cases you'll still need an accountant.

items.question: What happens if I go over 50 transactions on Free?
items.answer: New transactions won't be added that month on the Free plan — upgrade to Pro anytime to remove the limit.

items.question: Can I use it on my phone?
items.answer: Yes, Esep works in your browser on phone and desktop — no app to install.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Yes, anytime — no penalties or hidden terms.
